facts.statement: Persistent signed a 6.5-year engagement worth more than $650 million with a major technology company.
facts.quote: a large deal we signed last quarter, a 6.5-year engagement worth more than $650 million with one of the largest technology companies spanning product development support and cloud operations across multiple SaaS products.

facts.statement: The company operates its own software product business through Accelerite.
facts.quote: Through Accelerite, we have also operated our own software product business, which gave us the direct experience in building, selling, supporting, and sustaining enterprise software.

facts.statement: Teams hold nearly 25,000 partner certifications and over 58,000 AI certifications.
facts.quote: Our teams today hold nearly 25,000 partner certifications across Microsoft, AWS, Google Cloud, Salesforce, Databricks, and Snowflakes, and have earned more than 58,000 AI certifications to date.

facts.statement: Persistent received 6 awards at the ISG Provider Lens Awards 2026.
facts.quote: Persistent continued to receive multiple leadership recognitions from ISG in this quarter and received 6 awards at the ISG (Information Services Group) “Provider Lens Awards 2026”.
